levels.surface: أبو العباس أحمد بن محمد بن سعيد بن عقدة الكوفي
محمد بن المفضل بن إبراهيم بن قيس بن رمانة الأشعري

notes: Ali speaks inside the two narrators' story (narrated encounter, owner ruling 5): he is the last link after them; the Jewish questioner and Umar speak in the scene and are not links
«من كتابه» is a remark on the source book, not a link; «ربيب رسول الله» describes عمر and is left out
«قالا» and «قال: قالا» mark the two Companions as co-transmitters in one level (rule 2)
